title:
Small ring.
Big picture.
body:
Oura Ring 4 / Form & Function
CS2024 agency pitch by Alger, Tarence and Cheryl

title:
The goal is 20% sales growth
within three months
body:
Proposed measure: seller-confirmed completed orders during the three calendar months after campaign launch, compared with a comparable three-month baseline.

Growth = (campaign orders − baseline orders) / baseline orders × 100.
This is a target. No sales uplift has been observed or promised.

title:
Design thinking guides
the buying journey
body:
Empathise: desk research suggests three needs: sleep context, recovery and everyday activity.
Define: visitors need relevance, evidence, fit and ownership costs.
Ideate: persona routes converge on one buying-guide form.
Prototype: nine core pages plus five supporting pages.
Test: browser checks completed; physical-phone and target-user testing remain open.

title:
Research informs the copy,
with clear limits
body:
Official Oura sources support product, sizing and membership facts.
Shopee desk checks on 10 November 2026 found indexed Ring 4 pages marked Sold Out; current purchasable stock is not confirmed.
MOH and HealthHub provide wellness context, not evidence of Oura purchase intent.
No interviews, customer quotes or survey results are invented.

title: Three Singapore personas
body:
Michelle, 27 | Marketing executive | Sleep
Irregular bedtimes; asks what is behind a score. Sleep explains estimated stages and consistency.

Daniel, 36 | Product manager and runner | Recovery
Already owns a watch; Ring vs watch explains the complementary role.

Farid, 49 | Facilities manager | Activity
Wants discreet daily tracking; Activity explains movement and format.

Proposed personas, not interviewed customers. Each route ends at the guide.

title:
Creative brief
Form / Function
body:
Promise: help visitors decide whether Ring 4 fits their routine.
Tone: clear, precise and lightly playful.
Concept: the ring travels from a work desk through sensing to finish selection.
Primary conversion: create a personalised buying guide, then continue to the exact Shopee listing.
Campaign: S$20 voucher and sizing-kit support are proposals only, subject to retailer approval.

title: Font selection
body:
Arial / Helvetica: bold display headlines and clear body copy. Familiar system fonts load without external requests.
Georgia: editorial emphasis in feature and supporting-page headings.
Monospace system fallback: scene labels and technical captions.
Hierarchy: oversized short headings, readable body copy, compact secondary labels. Important buying information stays in body text.

title: Theme selection
body:
Olive #30372E: quiet technical setting.
Cream #F2E8D2: warm high-contrast text and information sections.
Orange #E08750: accents and focus indication.
Titanium rendering and a measuring mat make the physical object tangible.
ORYZO informs interaction patterns. The code, copy and artwork are original.

title:
SEO supports
specific buying questions
body:
Live website: gogogerr.github.io/cs2024-oura/
Search themes: Oura Ring 4 Singapore, sleep tracker, readiness, fitness, sizing and membership cost.
Each core page has an individual title, description, H1, internal links and canonical URL. XML sitemap is included.
Search Console submission and ranking outcomes are not verified. FAQ markup does not promise Google rich results.

title:
Content strategy
Answers before persuasion
body:
Relevant feature pages answer each persona’s main objection.
Sizing and membership copy explain practical buying decisions before the product link.
The free personalised guide is the working incentive; campaign benefits are labelled proposals.
Availability is a launch gate: verify an orderable size, seller terms and fulfilment before promoting purchases.
Validate persona assumptions with observed tasks; no conversion uplift is claimed.

title:
A three-month
marketing plan
table: Verify marketplace stock; agree baseline; test user tasks
Launch short product demos and search content about sizing and cost
Test benefits-first versus sizing-first guide CTAs
Guide completions and qualified product clicks
Improve weak steps and expand content that helps buying decisions
note: 20% is a three-month sales target, not a result. Hold paid promotion until stock is confirmed.

title: Buying guide and privacy
body:
Choose Sleep, Recovery or Activity and optional name, finish and size. No email field.
Required local-processing consent and separate optional future-updates preference are unticked.
The guide appears on-page and can be downloaded as text; the matching Shopee link follows the selected finish.
No data is submitted, no mailing subscription is created and no payment is taken. Clear the result to withdraw this local choice.

title: Publication and submission
body:
GitHub Pages is live at gogogerr.github.io/cs2024-oura/.
Browser checks cover navigation, phone layouts, ring controls, preferences and the guide form.
Still open: actual-phone missing-visual diagnosis, completed download verification and current buyable Ring 4 stock.
Submit the final published website link and this PowerPoint through NTULearn. Check that the final files and website agree.
